png_path = os.path.join(out_dir, 'fig1_architecture.png')

fig.savefig(pdf_path, format='pdf')
fig.savefig(png_path, format='png')
plt.close(fig)

print(f"Saved: {pdf_path}")
print(f"Saved: {png_path}")
